title: Rodriguez paper proposing to test DMT entities with prime factorization

tellings.quote: back in the early 2000s, uh a guy called Rodriguez published this paper

plain: A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore says on podcast host Jesse Michels's show that in the early 2000s a man named Rodriguez published a paper proposing a test for the beings people say they meet on DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug. The idea was to ask them to break a large number into its prime factors, a hard maths problem, to see whether they know things the person taking the drug could not.
